summary.summary: On 2026-01-20 between 03:40 and 03:42 UTC, the sshd service generated three high‑severity brute‑force alerts from the same source IP (ip_a10ffc688958). Ten failed attempts against root triggered the first alert, 30 failures across accounts triggered the second, and a successful login after 31 failures triggered a critical alert. This volume exceeds the configured thresholds and indicates a coordinated attack.
